decisions.text: Rule 4: the ignore ships inside each pack's export as its first block, { name: 'cookwright/<pack>/ignores', ignores: ['.claude/**', '.agents/**', '.codex/**'] }, no other key, so it is a global ignore wherever the spread lands; both packs carry it; nothing is written into the user's config beyond the spread lines init already writes.
Rule 3: the global block ignores the three pointer directories only; node_modules is ESLint's own default ignore, and the test globs stay per-block so a user's lint of their tests is theirs.
Rule 6: a repo with ESLint and the pointers but no pack has the same defect and no export to carry the fix; not observed yet, logged as E-056 with the setup-skill proposal, built when met.

Rule 3: the real-ESLint proof is the fixture (stage-4 disposition 25): after init it runs npx eslint . --format json and asserts no reported file under .claude/ and App.tsx reported under i18next/no-literal-string; the unit test asserts the block's shape and coverage.
Rule 3: the standards guide says a user's own lint run reports every violation at error severity, legacy ones included, while the hook and the gate judge only the change.
